title: The real-user browser audit and public productization correction (wave H)
recordedBy: the one implementation worker (browser audit + implementation + browser regression surface as one coherent delivery)
environment: worker sandbox: live public browser audit (agent-browser 0.38.1 against https://zeck-preview-main.vercel.app) + local two-function composition (deploy/local-experience-gateway.ts)
browserTool: agent-browser 0.38.1 (the audits) — served locally by deploy/local-experience-gateway.ts (the bootstrap API plane + deploy/experience.ts's buildExperienceHandler behind vercel.json's routing grammar, in-process)
doctrine: Every fact this record claims was produced by the environment named in it; every boundary the environment could not produce is a notRun entry with an owner. No capability is manufactured; the honest NOT RUN / provider-gated / requires-access states stay exactly as the machine manifest records them.

phaseA.target: https://zeck-preview-main.vercel.app (clean browser session, visible affordances only)

findings.reproduction: open the bare origin; observe the landed URL + title
findings.observed: 307 → /console; landed title 'Zeck — Developer console'; first h1 'Developer console'
findings.expected: the discovery-first Home experience (title 'Zeck — Home', the outcome statement, the families grid)
findings.userImpact: a first-time user lands on an internal developer surface; the product story never meets them
findings.rootCause: vercel.json's root redirect (correction #8's bridge) targeted /console — the PPR-001 discovery-first Home (route '/' in the dashboard table) was unreachable publicly: the platform's filesystem phase owns the bare '/' for the framework root function, so no rewrite can serve it
findings.smallestViableFix: retarget the redirect bridge to a canonical Home experience route (/home) served by the dashboard route table; make '/' a redirect on BOTH rails (public parity)
findings.alternatives: serving '/' directly from the experience function is impossible on the platform (the filesystem phase fact — the dead root rewrite, correction #8); redirecting to /console/catalog would surface capability but not the Home story
findings.verification: Phase C browser: open <gateway>/ → lands /home 'Zeck — Home' with the outcome statement

findings.reproduction: snapshot -i; click the Home link ref
findings.observed: stays on https://zeck-preview-main.vercel.app/console ('Zeck — Developer console') — Home ≡ Developer Console
findings.expected: the Home control resolves consistently to the Home experience
findings.userImpact: the primary navigation control is a masquerade; 'Home' is unreachable as a concept
findings.rootCause: shell.ts renders nav-home/brand/breadcrumb/mobile-bar Home affordances at href='/' and the public '/' bridges to /console
findings.smallestViableFix: a canonical HOME_PATH ('/home') every Home affordance addresses (nav control, brand, breadcrumb root, mobile bar) + the retargeted root bridge
findings.alternatives: leaving href='/' (it would redirect) keeps the masquerade one hop away and makes aria-current unsound
findings.verification: Phase C browser: clicking Home stays on /home; aria-current='page' on the Home control; the mobile bar's Home links /home

findings.reproduction: eval document.body.innerText on the landed console page
findings.observed: 'Describe an outcome. Zeck plans it, executes it under policy, and returns it with evidence.' NOT FOUND on the landing; the h1 is 'Developer console'
findings.expected: the outcome explanation is visibly and prominently on the Home experience (never buried below developer controls)
findings.userImpact: the first-time user is never told what the product does
findings.rootCause: the outcome statement lives in discoveryHero() on the dashboard Home route — the surface the landing never reached
findings.smallestViableFix: F01+F02 (the landing correction) — the Home hero IS the statement, rendered first on /home
findings.alternatives: duplicating the statement onto the console would create a second copy to maintain and bury it under developer controls
findings.verification: Phase C browser + tests: the gateway battery asserts the exact statement string on /home; the browser smoke asserts it visible on the landing

findings.reproduction: follow the visible 'Capability catalog' affordance; count families + states
findings.observed: the catalog (/console/catalog) serves all 22 families with truthful four-state chips (11 available / 6 requires-access / 2 provider-gated / 3 NOT RUN at audit time) — but discovery is NOT on the user's landing path and the families grid is not surfaced on it
findings.expected: capability discovery visible or one click away from Home
findings.userImpact: a first-time user cannot discover what workloads exist without learning the console's internal layout
findings.rootCause: the discovery grid (discoveryCatalogGrid) lives on the Home route the landing never reached
findings.smallestViableFix: F01+F02 — the Home grid + the catalog link are on the landing; the catalog keeps the existing machine-manifest projection (no manufactured capability)
findings.alternatives: none needed — the discovery surfaces exist and are truthful; only the landing path was wrong
findings.verification: Phase C browser: /home carries the 22-family grid (availability-grid links ≥ 22) + the catalog link; the catalog serves 22 rows with all four states

findings.routeOrInteraction: the first-execution golden path: guided start → review → 'Run sandbox execution' → the run detail redirect
findings.reproduction: drive the guided sandbox flow (the permitted synthetic summarization task) and observe where the browser lands
findings.observed: the run executes (real id 01a0da48-efae-7000-a00f-879ef23a30f8) but the redirect to /runs/<id> falls through to the API plane: raw Fastify JSON 404 '{"message":"Route GET:/runs/... not found"}' (content-type application/json) — the user's FIRST RUN ends in a raw error
findings.expected: the result surface (result, verification, activity, route, costs — 'How Zeck did it') opens on the experience plane
findings.userImpact: the single most important moment of the first-run journey is a dead end (the worst finding of the audit)
findings.rootCause: vercel.json exposed only /console/*, /trust/*, /admin/* and /assets/client.js to the experience function; every other visible route fell through to the API function
findings.smallestViableFix: the derived experience rewrite set covers /runs/* (and every other visible prefix)
findings.alternatives: redirecting the playground to the console explorer instead would leave the whole work surface broken
findings.verification: Phase C browser: /runs, /runs/history, /runs/<id> all serve HTML (the run detail renders the designed 403/404 HTML states on the unbound local rail; the credentialed live run renders the full result)

findings.routeOrInteraction: the visible 'Look up an execution by id' form (console executions page)
findings.observed: GET /executions?id=<id> falls through to the API plane: raw JSON 404
findings.expected: the lookup lands on the run detail
findings.userImpact: the only id-based discovery affordance is broken publicly
findings.rootCause: the form targeted the dashboard's legacy GET /executions path — API-plane on the public origin (POST /executions is the frozen create contract; rewrites are method-agnostic, so the path can never be experience-served)
findings.smallestViableFix: the form targets /runs (GET /runs?id= → 303 → /runs/<id>); the legacy /executions GET routes stay local-rail-only
findings.alternatives: a method-scoped rewrite of /executions cannot work (the platform's rewrites are method-agnostic and POST /executions must keep reaching the API)
findings.verification: gateway battery: GET /runs?id=<id> → 303 → /runs/<id>; the form's action is /runs; the browser smoke's visible-route sweep

findings.observed: raw JSON 422 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE (the API plane's machine boundary) where the nav promises a UI page
findings.expected: the agents inventory UI on the experience plane
findings.userImpact: a visible nav destination is a dead end of machine JSON
findings.rootCause: GET /agents is an architecture-pinned public API route (the machine inventory); the dashboard's agents PAGE at the same path+method can never be publicly served there
findings.smallestViableFix: the agents UI moves to /build/agents (+ /build/agents/:id); every internal link updated; the legacy local-rail routes kept (AC10); /agents stays API-plane
findings.alternatives: rewriting /agents to the experience function would break the SDK's GET /agents (the frozen public contract) — not admissible
findings.verification: Phase C browser: /build/agents serves HTML (the designed honest permission state on the unbound local rail); /agents stays JSON (the browser smoke's api-boundary step)

findings.reproduction: browser-probed each destination on the live plane
findings.observed: every one answered the API plane's raw JSON 404 ('Route GET:<path> not found') — 19 fall-through destinations beside F05/F07
findings.expected: every visible destination reaches the experience plane
findings.userImpact: the entire non-console information architecture is publicly unreachable
findings.rootCause: the vercel.json rewrite set covered only the console/trust/admin prefixes
findings.smallestViableFix: the derived rewrite set (deploy/experience-routing.ts): every dashboard-route prefix that does not collide with the API route table is rewritten to the experience function
findings.alternatives: a catch-all rewrite would shadow the machine routes (the API/experience boundary) — the derived per-prefix split preserves it
findings.verification: Phase C browser: all 30 traversed destinations serve HTML; the gateway battery derives the nav grammar's destinations from NAV_GROUPS/SIMPLE_NAV_ITEMS/MOBILE_NAV_ITEMS and asserts HTML for every one

findings.routeOrInteraction: the 'Library' group parent (/assets) — a visible breadcrumb link on every /assets/* page
findings.observed: no route exists at /assets in the dashboard table: publicly the raw JSON 404 (locally the dashboard 404 page)
findings.expected: the group parent the nav grammar links is a real surface
findings.userImpact: a broken breadcrumb link on three library surfaces
findings.smallestViableFix: GET /assets — a small honest Library overview (the three surfaces with their live/not-exposed states)
findings.alternatives: redirecting /assets → /assets/artifacts would pick a winner among siblings; the overview keeps the IA honest
findings.verification: Phase C browser: /assets serves 'Library' (HTML); the gateway battery's breadcrumb-parents assertion

findings.routeOrInteraction: desktop (1280) / tablet (834) / mobile (390) viewports + keyboard Tab pass over the landing
findings.reproduction: set viewport per class; drive Home → capability discovery → safe start; Tab from the top
findings.observed: PASSING baseline observations: skip link is the first focusable with :focus-visible; no horizontal scroll at any class; the mobile bottom bar renders (Home/Start/Catalog/Validation/Trust, targets ≥ 40px); reduced-motion + touch-target rules in the served CSS; no browser console errors. The single defect inherited: the mobile bar's Home and the landing itself were the masqueraded console (F01/F02)
findings.expected: the responsive/a11y baseline holds on the CORRECTED landing
findings.userImpact: none beyond F01/F02 (the frame itself is sound)
findings.rootCause: n/a (passing observations recorded; the defect was the landing target)
findings.verification: Phase C browser: mobile 390 (no h-scroll, bar visible, Home → /home, targets ≥ 40px), tablet 834 (sidebar, no h-scroll), keyboard (skip link first, focus-visible throughout)

findings.routeOrInteraction: the honest unavailable/provider-gated boundaries (browser-use, realtime-voice family pages; the credentials surface; the unauthenticated reading pages)
findings.reproduction: open the family pages across states; open /console/applications/keys
findings.observed: PASSING observations: provider-gated and NOT RUN families disclose their boundaries honestly (no fabricated capability); the credentials surface renders its designed state; no blank screens or misleading success states
findings.expected: the boundaries stay honest after the correction
findings.userImpact: none (the correction must not weaken these)
findings.rootCause: n/a (passing observations pinned so the correction cannot regress them)
findings.smallestViableFix: none — the four-state vocabulary and the manifest projection are untouched
findings.verification: the gateway battery's four-state catalog assertion + the representative-family states; the browser smoke's capability-catalog step

fixes: F01+F02+F03+F04 → vercel.json redirects / → /home; the dashboard route table serves GET /home (homePage — the discovery-first Home: outcome hero, 22-family grid, safe start, discovery entries) and turns GET / into the same /home redirect (both rails behave identically); shell.ts exports the canonical HOME_PATH and every Home affordance (nav control, brand, breadcrumb root, mobile bar) addresses it; discovery.ts's mobile bar follows

F05+F08 → vercel.json's rewrite set is the derived experience projection: /home, /build, /deployments, /runs, /assets, /improve, /command, /attention, /mode, /appearance (exact + :path* forms) alongside the existing /console, /trust, /admin — never the API-owned prefixes
F06 → lookupForm targets /runs; GET /runs carries the id-query redirect seam (303 → /runs/:id); the legacy /executions GET routes stay local-rail-only with the boundary documented in the route table

F07 → the agents UI lives at /build/agents (+ /build/agents/:agentId): NAV_GROUPS, the Build overview tile, the agent-detail links, the command suggestions and the learning record links all updated; the legacy local-rail /agents routes preserved (AC10); /agents stays the machine inventory
F09 → GET /assets — the honest Library overview

The deterministic sandbox substrate, the preview authority materialization and the economics/codebase-analysis seams are untouched — their honest unbound/NOT RUN states render exactly as before.
